description.content: Checks the health of this Submission Resource API.
Checks the version of this Submission Resource API.

Enables the creation and management of the flow of negotiations from an Underwriter to a Broker. Negotiations shown will be those which (1) have been formally communicated to the Broker; and (2) 'saved' Negotiation records (i.e. that are waiting to be sent to the Broker).
Returns a list of all Negotiation records based upon various query parameters. Pagination functionality is supported on this operation.

query.description:
The date timestamp when the entity was created.
Search using range method, e.g. createdDate=range(date1,date2).

The date timestamp when the entity was modified.
Search using range method, e.g. modifiedDate=range(date1,date2).

A system-generated unique identifier for a Contract, with a format and structure defined by the technology used.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. contractId=id1,id2,id3.

A system-generated unique identifier for a Participation, with a format and structure defined by the technology used.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. participationId=id1,id2,id3.

The name of the Broker Team, as defined by the broker organisation. 
Search using contains method, e.g. brokerTeamName=contains(astring).

The User email of the Broker User responsible for the Contract.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. brokerEmail=email1,email2,email3.

The First Name of the Broker User responsible for the Contract.
Search using contains method, e.g. brokerFirstName=contains(astring).

The Last Name of the Broker User responsible for the Contract.
Search using contains method, e.g. brokerLastName=contains(astring).

A system-generated unique identifier for an Underwriter Team, with a format and structure defined by the technology used.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. underwriterTeamId=id1,id2,id3.

The name of the Underwriter Team, as defined by the Carrier organisation.
Search using contains method, e.g. underwriterTeamName=contains(astring).

The User email of the Underwriter User responsible for the Negotiation.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. underwriterEmail=email1,email2,email3.

The First Name of the Underwriter User responsible for the Negotiation.
Search using contains method, e.g. underwriterFirstName=contains(astring).

The Last Name of the Underwriter User responsible for the Negotiation.
Search using contains method, e.g. underwriterLastName=contains(astring).

The User email of the Broker or Underwriter User that sent this Negotiation.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. sentByEmail=email1,email2,email3.

The First Name of the Broker or Underwriter User that sent this Negotiation.
Search using contains method, e.g. sentByFirstName=contains(astring).

The Last Name of the Broker or Underwriter User that sent this Negotiation.
Search using contains method, e.g. sentByLastName=contains(astring).

The type of the Negotiation.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. type=code1,code2,code3.

The subtype of the Negotiation.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. subType=code1,code2,code3.

The code that represents the Negotiation status, based upon the Type of Negotiation.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. status=code1,code2,code3.

Parameter used to return Negotiations records that have a leader role (true) or not (false).
Search using single exact match method, e.g. isLeader=true/false.

The code that represents the role or roles that the Underwriter plays through their participation.
Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. role=code1,code2,code3.

Parameter used to return Negotiation records that have at least one Line Condition (true) or no Line Conditions (false) present in any Stamp within a Participation, irrespective of the Status of the Line Condition.
Search using single exact match method, e.g. hasLineConditions=true/false.

Parameter used to return Negotiation records that have at least one Subjectivity (true) or no Subjectivities (false) present.
Search using single exact match method, e.g. hasSubjectivities=true/false.

Identifies whether the query results will return only the latest Negotiation record (true) or all Negotiation records (false) for each Participation. Search using single exact match method, e.g. showLatest=true/false.

Sorting field and order (unique field only).
Use + before the field name for ascending order, use - for descending order.
Number of the page to be retrieved.
Size of the page to be retrieved.

Search using multiple exact match method, e.g. negotiationId=id1,id2,id3.

description.content: Reassigns a Negotiation record to another Underwriter User. The destined Underwriter User does not have to be a member of the same Carrier Team owning the original Submission, but must exist within the same Company hierarchical structure. For the destined Underwriter User, either the entire Submission record is reassigned, or a new Submission record will be created (where there are multiple requests which remain with the original Underwriter User) for underwriting purposes.

description.content: Initiates the operation to send the latest Underwriter responses as part of a response to a Submission back to the Broker. The outcome of each Negotiation will either (1) agree unconditionally to the terms; (2) conditionally agree upon a change of terms; or (3) decline the offer.
